name: Missing Initialization
hint: A variable or attribute in your sprite is not initalized. It will use whatever value it contained at the end of the last run.
instruction: Is the executed program supposed to influence the next run of the program?[newLine]If not: Initialise the values of your variables and attributes, that have to have a certain value at the start of your program.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
(score)

when green flag clicked
forever
if <touching (edge v) ?> then
change [score v] by (1)
end
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
(score)

when green flag clicked
set [score] to (0) :: #007000 //⇦  👍
forever
if <touching (edge v) ?> then
change [score v] by (1)
end
end
